title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
title_zh: 面向事件驱动大语言模型智能体的主动记忆

paragraphs.en: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baselines. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/ .
paragraphs.zh: 主动式大语言模型智能体能够从持续观察和积累的历史中预见服务机会。 现有方法侧重于近期上下文或相关记忆的检索，对验证重复出现的行为规律以及评估其与当前事件的适用性支持有限。 我们提出主动记忆（ProactMem），它将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹和行为规律。 轨迹事实会与源事件进行核对，行为规律在匹配当前条件之前会先通过历史回放进行评估。 我们还构建了 ProactiveStream，这是一个覆盖三种应用范围的长时序基准，其中智能体在情境感知的机会标签下按时间顺序处理孤立的事件流。 在 ProactiveStream 上，ProactMem 取得了 52.6% 的整体有效性（F1），相比五个外部基线中最强的一个实现了 21.4% 的相对提升。 代码可在以下地址获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/ 。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents are extending task execution toward proactive assistance that identifies service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. In activity support, smart homes, and software collaboration, useful assistance depends on recognizing new needs, selecting relevant historical evidence, and tracking prior assistance.

paragraphs.en: Existing research addresses proactive assistance through service decisions and memory construction. ProactiveAgent learns task proposals from activity contexts ( Lu et al., 2025 ) ; ContextAgent combines sensed context with historical personas ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Mem0 consolidates and retrieves information ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , while A-MEM links historical notes ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . ProactiveBench and ContextAgentBench evaluate task proposals and contextual service; LoCoMo and LongMemEval assess long-term conversational memory ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Continuous assistance also requires assessing memory accumulation, current applicability, and changing opportunities within one event stream. This raises a central question: how can an agent turn accumulated history into reliable evidence for deciding when to offer assistance?
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究通过服务决策和记忆构建来处理主动式辅助。 ProactiveAgent 从活动上下文中学习任务提议（Lu et al., 2025）；ContextAgent 将感知到的上下文与历史用户画像相结合（Yang et al., 2025）。 Mem0 对信息进行整合与检索（Chhikara et al., 2025），而 A-MEM 则将历史笔记相互关联（Xu et al., 2025）。 ProactiveBench 和 ContextAgentBench 评估任务提议与情境化服务；LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 评估长期对话记忆（Maharana et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025）。 持续性辅助还需要评估记忆的累积、当前的适用性，以及同一事件流中不断变化的机会。 这就引出了一个核心问题：智能体如何将积累的历史转化为可靠的证据，以决定何时提供辅助？

paragraphs.en: LLMs construct cited trajectories from completed events, followed by source validation of typed facts. Historical replay assesses regularities inferred from these trajectories. At decision time, contextual assessment combines the current event, recent history, trajectories, and applicable regularities to judge service value. Intervention control filters repeated proposals; the finalized decision precedes event commitment and memory updates.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型从已完成的事件构建带引用的轨迹，随后对类型化事实进行来源验证。 历史重放用于评估从这些轨迹推断出的规律。 在决策时，情境评估结合当前事件、近期历史、轨迹以及适用的规律来判断服务价值。 干预控制会过滤重复的提案；最终确定的决策先于事件提交和记忆更新。

paragraphs.en: The base rate is the frequency of p p over observable days under the same time-window and weekday restrictions across both triggered and other observable days. A zero denominator gives a zero score. Confidence measures consistency across observable triggered days, whereas lift accounts for how common the expected behavior is under comparable temporal restrictions. A frequently observed activity can yield high confidence even when it also occurs without the trigger. Comparing the two frequencies makes this distinction explicit when assessing a proposed regularity. The support requirement further ensures that activation rests on repeated observations across distinct days.
paragraphs.zh: 基准率是 p p 在相同时间窗口与星期几限制下，在触发日与其他可观测日两类日子上的出现频率。 分母为零时得分为零。 置信度衡量的是各可观测触发日之间的一致性，而提升度则考虑在可比的时间限制下预期行为有多常见。 即使某活动在没有触发的情况下也会发生，频繁出现的活动仍可能产生较高的置信度。 在评估一个拟议的规律时，比较这两个频率可以使这一区别变得明确。 支持度要求进一步确保该激活建立在跨越不同日子的重复观察之上。

paragraphs.en: We compare ProactMem with five external methods on ProactiveStream.

paragraphs.en: Across all three scopes, ProactMem achieves higher effectiveness and balance than the external baselines (Table 2 , RQ1). The comparison reflects different trade-offs across scopes. On Sports, Mem0 attains greater coverage alongside more false interventions; ProactMem is more selective, with higher relevance and lower intrusion. On Home, ProactMem recovers more opportunities than every external baseline, with fewer false interventions than the higher-frequency A-MEM and Graphiti. On Code, it likewise obtains the highest coverage, whereas Mem0 achieves lower intrusion with substantially less opportunity recovery. paragraphs.en: We introduced ProactiveStream to evaluate proactive assistance over event streams as history accumulates. ProactMem combines recent events, source-checked temporal trajectories, and replay-assessed behavioral regularities, bringing evidence from earlier observations into current decisions. Across Sports, Home, and Code, it achieves higher effectiveness and balance than the evaluated baselines. The memory ablations further show improved opportunity recovery with trajectories and fewer false interventions with the full hierarchy. These results support maintaining historical evidence at multiple temporal scales for event-driven proactive assistance .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ProactiveStream，用于在历史不断累积的过程中评估事件流上的主动式辅助。 ProactMem 结合了近期事件、经来源核查的时间轨迹以及经回放评估的行为规律，将来自早期观察的证据引入当前决策。 在 Sports、Home 和 Code 三个场景中，它比所评估的基线方法取得了更高的有效性与均衡性。 记忆消融实验进一步表明，轨迹带来了机会召回的提升，而完整的分层结构减少了错误干预。 这些结果支持在多个时间尺度上维护历史证据，以实现事件驱动的主动式辅助。

sents.en: These results support maintaining historical evidence at multiple temporal scales for event-driven proactive assistance .

paragraphs.en: ProactiveStream covers low-risk service settings in Sports, Home, and Code under a protocol fixed after joint method and benchmark development. Independent held-out evaluation and cross-family transfer of constructed memory remain future work. Reference labels represent service opportunities under the annotation protocol; the 450-target review assesses three selected streams. The Code suppression diagnostic holds later states fixed; controller-free behavior requires a sequential comparison. Historical replay assesses observed support; prospective validity under changing behavior requires further study. Our offline metrics evaluate opportunity detection. Recipient benefit, interruption burden, end-to-end cost, and deployment safety require prospective measurements. The reported results support comparisons within the evaluated protocols, with broader generalization depending on additional populations, observation conditions, and model families.
paragraphs.zh: ProactiveStream 在联合完成方法与基准开发后固定的协议下，覆盖 Sports、Home 与 Code 中的低风险服务设置。 构建的记忆的独立留存评估与跨模型族迁移仍是未来的工作。 参考标签表示标注协议下的服务机会；450 条目标的复核评估三个选定的流。 Code 抑制诊断将后续状态固定；无控制器行为需要进行顺序比较。 历史回放评估观察到的支持；在行为变化下的前瞻有效性需要进一步研究。 我们的离线指标评估机会检测。 接收方收益、打断负担、端到端成本以及部署安全性需要前瞻性测量。 所报告的结果支持在所评估协议内的比较，更广泛的泛化则取决于更多的群体、观测条件和模型族。

paragraphs.en: CASAS ( Cook et al., 2013 ) supplies ambient-sensor traces from four homes over 14 consecutive days each. Per local day, ten-minute source blocks are assigned exactly once to 28 regular 50-minute segments and one 40-minute tail, yielding 406 events per home. A segment becomes available only after interval closure and contains within-interval motion counts, room sequences, door actions, and compact numeric summaries. Gentle check-ins exclude disease, fall, travel, danger, and unsupported preference inference.
paragraphs.zh: CASAS（Cook等人，2013）提供了四个家庭各连续14天的环境传感器轨迹。 按当地日计算，十分钟源数据块被恰好分配一次至28个常规的50分钟片段和一个40分钟的尾段，每个家庭产生406个事件。 片段仅在区间闭合后可用，包含区间内的动作计数、房间序列、门操作以及紧凑的数值摘要。 温和的问候询问排除疾病、跌倒、旅行、危险以及不受支持的偏好推断。

paragraphs.en: Public repository activity, including GH Archive records ( Grigorik, 2026 ) , supplies 1,459 events across four repositories with 174 reference interventions. Pushes, issue updates, pull-request actions, and reviews retain GitHub’s native event granularity, with one decision per event. Records are ordered by timestamp and then event ID. Each repository owns isolated memory and intervention state even when contributors overlap. Services cover low-risk triage, review, and maintenance; native PushEvent records enter the stream.

paragraphs.en: The trajectory construction step uses an independent buffer of all committed events from the open local day, cleared after processing. Activity segments contain a local interval, typed observed , context-before , and outcome fields, plus source event identifiers. The checks in Equation 5 canonicalize scalar values, accept exact or schema-preserving suffix field paths, and require consistent entities, intervals, and resolved citations. Validation and replay operate on typed evidence. Accepted trajectories remain in the current construction cycle after their events leave event memory.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹构建步骤使用一个独立的缓冲区，存放来自开放本地日的所有已提交事件，并在处理完成后清空。 活动片段包含一个本地区间、带类型的 observed、context-before 与 outcome 字段，以及源事件标识符。 公式 5 中的检查会对标量值进行规范化，接受精确匹配或保留模式的后缀字段路径，并要求实体、区间和已解析引用保持一致。 验证与重放基于带类型的证据进行。 在其事件离开事件记忆后，被接受的轨迹仍保留在当前构建周期中。

sents.en: The trajectory construction step uses an independent buffer of all committed events from the open local day, cleared after processing.
sents.zh: 轨迹构建步骤使用一个独立的缓冲区，存放来自开放本地日的所有已提交事件，并在处理完成后清空。

sents.en: Activity segments contain a local interval, typed observed , context-before , and outcome fields, plus source event identifiers.
sents.zh: 活动片段包含一个本地区间、带类型的 observed、context-before 与 outcome 字段，以及源事件标识符。

sents.en: The checks in Equation 5 canonicalize scalar values, accept exact or schema-preserving suffix field paths, and require consistent entities, intervals, and resolved citations.

paragraphs.en: Empty or unobservable records also advance the seven-record construction cycle. Replay follows Equation 6 : a triggered, observable day is fulfilled when the expected behavior occurs at or after the trigger within the window; otherwise it is violated. Missing observations are censored, each date counts at most once, and the base rate includes triggered and other observable days under the same time and weekday restrictions. Confidence and lift have zero-denominator scores of zero.
paragraphs.zh: 空记录或不可观测的记录同样会推进七记录构建周期。 重放遵循公式6：当一个被触发的可观测日中，预期行为在触发时刻或之后、且在时间窗口内发生，则该日被判定为满足；否则判定为违反。 缺失的观测被删失处理，每个日期最多计入一次，基线比率包含在同时间与同星期几限制条件下的被触发日及其他可观测日。 置信度与提升度在分母为零时记为零分。

sents.en: Empty or unobservable records also advance the seven-record construction cycle.
sents.zh: 空记录或不可观测的记录同样会推进七记录构建周期。

sents.en: Replay follows Equation 6 : a triggered, observable day is fulfilled when the expected behavior occurs at or after the trigger within the window; otherwise it is violated.
sents.zh: 重放遵循公式6：当一个被触发的可观测日中，预期行为在触发时刻或之后、且在时间窗口内发生，则该日被判定为满足；否则判定为违反。

sents.en: Missing observations are censored, each date counts at most once, and the base rate includes triggered and other observable days under the same time and weekday restrictions.
sents.zh: 缺失的观测被删失处理，每个日期最多计入一次，基线比率包含在同时间与同星期几限制条件下的被触发日及其他可观测日。

sents.en: Confidence and lift have zero-denominator scores of zero.
sents.zh: 置信度与提升度在分母为零时记为零分。

paragraphs.en: After admission, confidence combines replay and online counts in a support ratio smoothed with one initial success and failure; censored observations preserve both counts. Two consecutive violations move an active regularity to weakening , lowering retrieval priority; four move it to dormant . A fulfilled observation restores a weakening regularity to active at confidence ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . Dormant regularities return to candidate for replay readmission.
paragraphs.zh: 录取后，置信度通过支持率将重放计数与在线计数相结合，该支持率以一次初始成功和一次初始失败进行平滑；被删失的观测同时保留两种计数。 连续两次违规会将处于活跃状态的规律转为弱化，降低其检索优先级；连续四次违规则将其转为休眠。 一次满足的观测会在置信度 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 时将弱化的规律恢复为活跃。 休眠的规律会回到候选状态，等待重放重新录取。

sents.zh: 录取后，置信度通过支持率将重放计数与在线计数相结合，该支持率以一次初始成功和一次初始失败进行平滑；被删失的观测同时保留两种计数。

sents.en: A fulfilled observation restores a weakening regularity to active at confidence ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 .
sents.zh: 一次满足的观测会在置信度 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 时将弱化的规律恢复为活跃。

sents.en: Dormant regularities return to candidate for replay readmission.
sents.zh: 休眠的规律会回到候选状态，等待重放重新录取。

paragraphs.en: Current matching is deterministic. Retrieval admits upcoming, pending, or deviated occurrences of active or weakening regularities. Occurrence priority is deviated, followed by pending and upcoming.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的匹配是确定性的。 检索允许活跃或正在减弱的规律即将发生、待处理或已偏离的出现。 出现的优先级是已偏离，其次是待处理和即将发生。

paragraphs.en: In Sports and Home, the intervention key combines scope-specific episode state, proposed service action and target, and sorted regularity identifiers available in context. paragraphs.zh: 在 Sports 和 Home 中，干预键由特定于作用域的片段状态、提议的服务动作与目标，以及上下文中可用的已排序规律标识符组合而成。 简单摘要或图事实会提供空的规律标识符列表。 Sports 状态包含可用性和活动；Home 状态包含活动、房间，以及在一次、两次和三次及以上连续匹配观测时的起始、确认和持续阶段。 在没有显式片段键的情况下，特定于作用域的时间或目标字段用于识别机会，并且还需要证据保持不变以进行重复抑制。 状态变化、序列重启、服务或规律标识符变更，以及本地日切换都可能生成新键。

paragraphs.en: A model-assisted post-hoc analysis on these targets reconstructs episodes defined by service goals and objects from positive event anchors. Each reference specifies a service goal and object, causal evidence, onset, explicitly listed valid observations, and any deadline or closure evidence. Semantic matching uses these fields to associate interventions with reference episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 对这些目标进行模型辅助的事后分析，从正向事件锚点重构由服务目标与服务对象定义的事件片段。 每个参照片段都指明了服务目标与服务对象、因果证据、起始时间、明确列出的有效观察，以及任何截止时间或结案证据。 语义匹配利用这些字段将干预措施与参照片段关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Episode coverage follows ProactMem’s own interventions, initialized from recorded prefix outputs. Only target interventions are scored. An intervention must match the goal and object at a listed valid observation. Its proposed service time is the decision time plus its specified delay (zero for immediate service), and must meet any explicit episode deadline. The first timely match covers the episode. Each output receives at most one credit: the first uncovered compatible episode in the fixed reference order, otherwise the first already covered one.
paragraphs.zh: 剧情覆盖遵循 ProactMem 自身的干预，并从记录的前缀输出初始化。 只有目标干预会被评分。 干预必须在所列的有效观察处匹配目标与对象。 其提出的服务时间是决策时间加上其指定的延迟（立即服务则为零），且必须满足任何明确的剧情截止时间。 第一次及时匹配即覆盖该剧情。 每个输出最多获得一次积分：在固定参考顺序中，先匹配第一个未被覆盖的兼容剧情，否则匹配第一个已被覆盖的剧情。

paragraphs.en: Subsequent matches are compared with the method’s preceding assistance for that episode. A valuable follow-up requires new causal evidence that changes the actionable service or next step, and a message addressing that change. Rephrasing or continued status alone is redundant; value requiring unobserved delivery, recipient response, or completion remains uncertain. Each reference episode receives coverage credit once.
paragraphs.zh: 后续匹配将与该方法在该情节中的先前协助进行比较。 有价值的后续需要新的因果证据，能够改变可执行的服务或下一步骤，并伴随一条针对该变化的消息。 仅重新表述或持续的状态汇报是冗余的；需要未被观测到的交付、接收方响应或完成情况的价值仍不确定。 每个参考情节只获得一次覆盖得分。
